The co-main event is the "UFC World Bantamweight Title Match" (5 minutes, 5 rounds), where former champion Merab Dvalishvili (Georgia) challenges champion Pyotr Yan (Russia). Yan defends his title with a 5th round decision win in a rubber match against Dvalishvili.
